title: Kicked Ethiopian Eggplant Tibs
description: A spicy twist on traditional Ethiopian eggplant tibs, featuring lardons-render and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the clarified butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the lardons-render and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced eggplants to the skillet and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the red pepper flakes, paprika, salt, black pepper, and nigella seeds to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the eggplants are tender and the spices are fragrant.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the kicked Ethiopian eggplant tibs hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
